data.about: A six-panel parallel-chord truss under equal loads at every top joint. A trial funicular finds the resultant and the division point i that splits the load line into the two reactions; then the force diagram grows joint by joint — every joint of the truss closes its own polygon of member forces (a Cremona diagram). Toggle between Howe and Pratt diagonals: the same loads, the same chords, but the web forces swap — Howe diagonals push (compression), Pratt diagonals pull (tension).

steps.caption: step through with the slider, press play, or use ←/→
steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: left: six panels — loaded top chord A…H, bottom chord C…N on the supports, members numbered 1…25; the panel toggles Howe ↔ Pratt diagonals
steps.title: The truss

steps.caption: left: F₁ … F₇ at every top joint, on dashed lines of action — right: laid off tip-to-tail down the load line
steps.title: The loads — in both diagrams

steps.caption: right: any pole o′ with rays to the load points — left: a trial funicular below the truss: from Q′, one string ∥ each ray
steps.title: Trial pole o′

steps.caption: left: the outer strings extended (dashed) meet on R's line of action at midspan — right: R = ΣF spans the whole load line; dashed green in BOTH diagrams
steps.title: The resultant R

steps.caption: left: dashed closing Q′–P₆ — right: the parallel through o′ cuts the load line at i
steps.title: Closing line → division point i

steps.caption: i splits the load line: A = i→Z, B = H₁→i, drawn on an offset line for clarity — left: A and B push up at the supports; the trial has done its job
steps.title: The reactions A and B

steps.caption: Howe: at joint A chord 2 carries nothing, so post 1 takes F₁ straight down — force 1 lies on the load line (Pratt: joint C — post 1 carries the whole reaction A: force 1 = Z→i)
steps.title: Joint by joint: the end post

steps.caption: Howe: joint C — through A₁ ∥ diagonal 3, through i ∥ chord 4: with A and force 1 the polygon closes (Pratt: joint A — chord 2 and diagonal 3 close over F₁ and 1)
steps.title: The support corner closes

steps.caption: Howe: joint B — chord 6 through B₁ and post 5 through S₁ close over F₂ and 3 (Pratt: joint I — post 5 and chord 8 close over diagonal 3)
steps.title: First panel

steps.caption: Howe: joint I — diagonal 7 and chord 8 back to the level of i (Pratt: joint B — chord 6 and diagonal 7 close over F₂ and 5)
steps.title: … and its partner joint

steps.caption: Howe: joint D — chord 10 through C₁, post 9 (Pratt: joint J — post 9 and chord 12)
steps.title: Second panel

steps.caption: Howe: joint J — diagonal 11, chord 12 back to i (Pratt: joint D — chord 10 and diagonal 11)
steps.title: … and its partner joint

steps.caption: Howe: chord 14 and diagonal 15 close joint E — the mid post 13 carries NOTHING (Pratt: post 13 = F₄ in compression and chord 14)
steps.title: Midspan joint E

steps.caption: Howe: chord 16 mirrors 12 — the diagram turns symmetric about i (Pratt: diagonal 15 and chord 16 close joint K)
steps.title: Bottom joint K

steps.caption: Howe: joint L — post 17 and chord 20 (Pratt: joint F — post 17 and chord 18)
steps.title: Third panel, mirrored

steps.caption: Howe: joint F — chord 18 and diagonal 19 (Pratt: joint L — diagonal 19 and chord 20)
steps.title: … and its partner joint

steps.caption: Howe: joint M — post 21 and chord 24 (Pratt: joint G — post 21 and chord 22)
steps.title: Toward the far support

steps.caption: Howe: joint G — diagonal 23 closes it; chord 22 carries nothing (Pratt: joint M — diagonal 23 closes over 20, 21 and 24 = 0)
steps.title: Last web member

steps.caption: Howe: joint N — post 25 = F₇ returns on the load line and the reaction B closes the joint (Pratt: joint H — post 25 carries the whole of B down to the support)
steps.title: The far support

steps.caption: every side of its polygon is already drawn — Howe: joint H (Pratt: joint N) closes for free: the Cremona diagram is complete
steps.title: The last joint is the check

steps.caption: blue = compression, pink = tension — Howe: diagonals push, verticals tie; Pratt: diagonals tie, posts push. Toggle Howe ↔ Pratt, drag A, Z or the loads, click any joint to inspect its equilibrium
steps.title: Compression and tension
